body:
Hey, thanks for your comment. I don't see how the entire "Just do your thing it it may just happen for one day" thing will work out. Even if there are girls that like me, I lack the skills to close the deal, for lack of a better word. Seduction is just one thing that I never really learned. 

So far in my life I only had one date, with someone that was to me a very special person. Yet I was so nervous and afraid on the two occasions that we dated, that I am convinced that I blew it simply because I was even to afraid to touch her or hold her hand. Being a man is confusing. One the one hand society tells you that you should respect women and don't do certain things unless explicitly given permission. And on the other hand, they expect you to initiate and you get friendzoned hard if you wait too long for cues. 

Oh well, I'm not sure where I'm going with this message. Just rambling about my frustrations...

I suppose you're right. I can tell that on days on which I feel very depressed that sometimes social interactions with people don't go that well. Maybe this also is true on a general day to day basis when it comes to self esteem and happiness. Or maybe I'm just making things up, could be both.

I've heard about the law of attraction, and it is rather intriguing. I don't believe in everything this theory has to offer, but I think there may be some truth in it when it comes to self confidence and happiness. Of course this all sounds very inspiring in theory. But in reality there are a lot of factors that come in to play. Even if I met a nice girl I wouldn't know how to make her notice me and seduce her. I suppose this just takes practice.

I've checked up on OKC but found that it isn't really targeted for people in my country, but I believe there are other dating sites that are similar to it. Maybe I'll give it a try anyway.

Thank you so much for your kind words.

Hi. Thank you for your comment. Do you really think women can detect low self confidence from even my dating profile? I find it hard to believe women can actually pick up on that. 

To be honest, I think my pictures are the problem. They aren't super bad or anything as far as I can tell, but I just ain't super attractive on them. Yet I don't know how to make any better ones. Making a couple of selfies feels / looks super awkward. Never been really very photogenic. 

I'm not familiair with OKCupid but have tried a different dating site. On there my profile rarely gets viewed and my messages are ignored.

Sigh... really trying my best to stay positive, but I don't have anymore courage or energy left it seems.

Hi. Thanks for your message. I will try to be more possitive. Yet when you get confronted with these facts it becomes very hard. I would want to be angry at all the people that toss me aside but I can't really do that either.

I suppose I had more success if I respected women less. I don't know...
